name: old-cat-clock
description: 耄猫时钟 - Electron 客户端 + Vue 管理后台 + NestJS 服务端

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @maomao/server && npm run build -w @maomao/admin && npm run build -w @maomao/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,admin -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @maomao/server" "npm run dev -w @maomao/admin"
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,admin,desktop -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @maomao/server" "npm run dev -w @maomao/admin" "npm run dev -w @maomao/desktop"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @maomao/server
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @maomao/admin
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @maomao/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @maomao/server && npm run typecheck -w @maomao/admin && npm run typecheck -w @maomao/desktop
